description: Deploy-owned registry: which Hermes agent tools must run under run-under-omnibox when OMNIBOX_ENABLED=1 (Mode A / cbd-o9s.11).
notes: Vault-only tools need not go through Omnibox unless their implementation shells out.
Contributor allowlist still denies shell_exec; Omnibox does not elevate contributor.
Product Hermes must honor this registry (or an equivalent hard-coded set) when OMNIBOX_ENABLED=1.
Missing session profile fails closed to contributor grants for wrap profile resolution.
